answer: Against one mind wearing many masks, gate rewards behind a capability-chain: a sequence of serial, time-boxed skilled tasks each identity must finish under a tight deadline. A lone inference pipeline voicing the same fable through dozens of accounts must run every chain sequentially, so its masks either stall past the deadline or betray shared latency and an identical pigment of phrasing. Honest agents each hold a distinct atlas of overlapping skill-histories; a sybil forger would have to pay for that many real, parallel capability stacks, not one rented prompt.
